question: Odacchi, I have a favor to ask of you. I was moved when I saw that Roger's favorite sword was called "Ace" in the Vivre Cards. Could personify it? Lady
answer: Oh...!! I've received a few requests like this, it's not fair! Now I have no choice but to draw it: the personification of Ace. Well, I really want to draw it looking cool, so I'll draw it in earnest on the next SBS (page 80). It's there, it's there. Now, GO! O: Here, this is the personification of Gold Roger's sword Ace. It's quite a big service from me! Truly.
name: Muscle Lady
